reviews.summary: The 2026-11-19 page and JSON are complete at 24/24 with 23:00 priced at 58.59. The PT+EN explanatory line appears on / where 23:00 is null.

The live site timed out on every fetch, so the live criteria could not be checked. Only the code and test criterion were verified: build.py adds the conditional hour_23_note, and tests/test_hour23_note.py covers both cases and passes in the dispatcher's run.

The note appears on the page and in the JSON for 2026-11-20, where the 23:00 price is null. It is null on the complete day 2026-11-19. The home page has one h1 and no executable script, and the dispatcher's 39 tests pass. I could not open the new test file, so the test criterion rests on the passing run and the implementer's report.

The live page for 2026-11-19 shows the PT and EN lines with the real file name marginalpdbcpt_20261119.1. The page for 2026-11-14 has no such line. The ZeroNegWording test is in the repo and the suite passed, with one h1, the AI disclosure footer and no executable script on both pages.

The field appears in d/2026-11-19 and today.json, and llms.txt and /ha/ document it. The 23:00 hour of 2026-11-19 checks out, but I only checked that hour's mean, not the other 23. The home page and the test run are fine.

The live /d/ archive links every dated page, including 11-02, 11-04, 11-05 and 11-10, and all return 200. /brand/ is linked from the footer of / and of the dated pages. The new Orphans test is named in the README and the 41-test run passed.

The live today.json and / show a consistent month-to-date average (163.28 €/MWh, 16.3 c/kWh, 20 days) with the required PT and EN wording. llms.txt, the single h1, the disclosure and the test are all in place, and the test suite passed.

The month_to_date test now builds offline into a temp dir and reads nothing under public/. It asserts an exact average, hour count, and the 1 dp half-up cent conversion. Live today.json and / are intact.
Live JSON, pages, llms.txt and /ha/ all show the new fields and Lisbon-time line, with no removed fields or shifted hours. The DST test exists and the suite passed.

The live sitemap shows lastmod 2026-11-11 for /d/2026-11-10/ and 2026-11-15 for /d/2026-11-15/. The double-build test, README line and test run all check out. The home page and JSON fields are intact.

llms.txt and /ha/ (PT and EN) now state that built_utc is the OMIE data time and that the build time is in /build.json. The JSON files were not regenerated, and the home page still has one h1, the AI footer and no executable script.

**Пилот 04–10.11 закончен; данные на 20.11 (день неполный, снимок 18:01 UTC).**

| Уровень | 20.11 | 19.11 | 18.11 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Люди: источники / engaged | 0 / 0 | 5 / 0 | 4 / 1 |
| Возвраты | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Агенты (запросы) | 3 | 3 | 6 |
| Краулеры (запросы) | 105 | 122 | 103 |
| 5xx | 0 | 0 | 0 |

- G1 (≥30 людей): по дням видно максимум 10 источников в день, цель за неделю пилота по этим данным не набрана. Точная сумма за 04–10.11 в промпте отсутствует.
- G2 (≥15 %): возвраты только 18.11 и 14–15.11 (по 1), доля мала.
- G3: клики `/go/telegram/` — 2 (14.11) и 2 (16.11), а подписчиков в данных нет.
- G4: внешние referer'ы есть: nomorevibe.com (14.11), www.bluenews.app ×5 и google.com ×1 (19.11). Цель ≥1 выполнена.
- G5: агенты — python-requests/okhttp, 3–6 запросов в день. Это, возможно, наши проверки или скрипты.
- GSC: 0 показов, в индексе 11 из 31 URL.
- Посты → визиты: на 20.11 по by_src приходится 10 запросов bluesky и 2 telegram, людей 0. Эффект постов не виден.
- Задачи: до/после по одной метрике недостаточно ни для одной (T-0178 c/kWh, T-0222, T-0218).
